item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
To counter Djoric: I hate this I hate this I hate this.

The first of these stories was funny in its own right, the second one was interesting. But this new one is just dull. It's a meta-rant about how tired AWCY? is, and a boring one at that.

However, what really gets me is Duchamp. He is like the perfect incapsulation of everything that people hate about AWCY?, from the "so-clever-but-not-really" psudeonym to the "fuck you maaaaaan" art displays. Now, I love me some AWCY? but with three tales in as many days about this dickhead, I am thoroughly sick and tired of reading about. Maybe he's intentionally an obnoxious asshole, to make a statement about… something, but here's the thing: he's still an obnoxious asshole. There's nothing about him that's particularly endearing, or even interesting. It's like you decided that Duck Amuck needed a great deal of expansion and so wrote several tales of decreasing quality to do it. Sometimes one-shot characters are one-shot for a reason.

I disagreed with the people who thought that OMG CHARACTERIZATION WILL RUIN THE SITE, but if this is the kind of crap it brings us, then maybe they're on to something.

Downvoted for Saturn Deer… WITH AAAAAART.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I'm not attempting to overwrite any old canon with this; as far as I know, The Sculptor and The Clipper have only ever been used in The Critic, where they really just had a passing mention. My goal with Ruiz is to diversify the cast of AWCY, as the main focuses of AWCY stories have always been The Critic or one-off anartists. Not to mention that I've at least sprinkled some characterisation on two characters who were previously one-dimensional, which hopefully might get people thinking about what the other anartists in The Critic's "cabal" are actually like outside of the one time we've seen them.

This is most excellent. I like Ruiz, now, a lot. There was a hint at his "artistic megalomania" before but here it really comes out. But now, seeing all his power, it's very possible that the nitrogen shower didn't kill him.

I liked the subtle hints that he may have been memetically affecting them, with the pizza ordering and the continued double entendres. They're subtle enough that they could be written off as entirely benign.
